## peaceful-jar

### Description and Rationale
I am an aerospace engineer with a strong background in simulation, programming and data analysis. I decided to participate in the PRC Data Challenge because it combines aviation operations with data-driven modelling and offers an opportunity to explore real-world airport operations. My goal is to develop and evaluate practical approaches for predicting taxi-out times while learning from a challenging real aviation dataset.
